title: Malling Nallah slide zone (NH-5, Kinnaur)
description: A long-running slide zone between Khab and Nako. Rockfall and mud flows can block the road for hours after rain.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory. Check HP PWD / police updates.

title: Karcham–Sangla road
description: A narrow cliff road prone to rockfall in rain and freeze-thaw. Travel in daylight and don't stop under loose slopes.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Parvati river: Bhuntar to Barshaini
description: The Parvati rises fast after cloudbursts upstream. Stay off riverbank rocks and don't camp on gravel bars.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Kiratpur–Manali highway, Pandoh to Aut
description: Slides and road damage are common in monsoon. Expect long delays, and avoid driving at night.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Snow-melt stream crossings near Balu ka Ghera
description: Streams swell through the afternoon. Cross before noon, unclip your backpack hip belt and face upstream.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Batal–Chandratal road crossings
description: Glacial streams cross the road and run highest in the afternoon. Vehicles can get stuck; cross early.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Leopard activity around McLeodganj and Dharamkot
description: Leopards are regularly sighted at dawn and dusk on forest trails. Don't walk alone after dark, and keep pets leashed.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Black bear habitat, Kareri valley
description: Himalayan black bears forage in the oak forest, especially in autumn. Make noise on the trail and store food away from your tent.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Bear country, GHNP buffer and Jalori forests
description: Black bears live in the forests around Rolla and Serolsar. Walk in groups and avoid dusk on forest trails.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Snakes on lower-valley trails in monsoon
description: Snakes are active on warm, wet lower slopes. Wear closed shoes, use a torch at night and watch where you step.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Exposed ridge: Triund
description: Afternoon thunderstorms are common in summer and monsoon. Leave the ridge as soon as you hear thunder.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Churdhar summit lightning
description: The isolated summit draws strikes. Summit early and be below the tree line by early afternoon.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Rockfall on the Beas Kund moraine
description: Loose boulders on the moraine shift with snow-melt. Move in single file and don't rest under the slopes.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: Snow slopes below Indrahar Pass
description: Late and early-season snow makes the gully avalanche-prone. Only cross with a guide who knows current conditions.
source_note: Team summary of commonly reported risks; not an official advisory.

title: High altitude: Kaza and the upper villages
description: You'll be sleeping at about 3,800 m. Arrive gradually through Kinnaur and take a rest day before going higher.
source_note: Based on Wilderness Medical Society altitude guidance.
